caption:
Delighted to have joined the @YOUNGO Energy Working Group for a discussion on how youth can lead the sustainable energy revolution.
 
We discussed how to lift people out of energy poverty and ensure inclusive just transitions through exploring the potential of e-mobility; how AI solutions can drive energy access; and climate negotiations and energy policy.
 
Three key points stood out from the discussion:

1️⃣  Rethink the framing – we must ask ourselves, what can be done to leapfrog beyond the confines of the traditional renewable energy practices to deliver a sustainable energy revolution.

2️⃣  AI solutions need to put human development at front at centre – While AI can optimize energy systems, we must ensure it doesn’t exacerbate inequalities or divert resources from urgent priorities like universal energy access.

3️⃣  Inclusion and energy equality is non-negotiable – From youth, women to Indigenous communities, all voices must shape energy policies and negotiations to create equitable and lasting impact.
 
Thank you to YOUNGO Energy Working Group for pushing the boundaries to imagine an energy revolution to drive a net-zero future for all!💡
 
I invite you all to re-watch the session here: https://lnkd.in/etPxbKGv
